description: This file defines a package-private final class 'NameScope' used to manage hierarchical names for operators within the TensorFlow Java API. It provides methods to create sub-scopes, generate unique operator names, and manage scope hierarchies, primarily for internal use in TensorFlow's graph construction and visualization.

classes.name: NameScope
classes.description: A package-private class that manages hierarchical, scoped names for TensorFlow operators, ensuring unique operator naming within scopes and facilitating organized graph structures.

methods.name: withSubScope
methods.description: Creates a new NameScope instance representing a sub-scope within the current scope, appending a new component to the hierarchy.

methods.name: withName
methods.description: Creates a new NameScope with a specific name, sharing context from the current scope.

methods.name: makeOpName
methods.description: Generates a fully qualified operator name, ensuring uniqueness within the scope hierarchy.

methods.name: NameScope (constructor)
methods.description: Creates a root-level NameScope with no initial prefix or name.

methods.name: makeUnique
methods.description: Generates a unique name by appending a numeric suffix if the base name has been used before.

methods.name: fullyQualify
methods.description: Constructs a fully qualified name by combining the scope prefix with a given name.
